author: discordfa8
quote: I really wanted to love GTA 6, especially if you consider waiting so many years, but so far I'm completely disappointed. The graphics are crazy, the world looks very good and the technical work Rockstar has done deserves a lot of respect. But this alone doesn't make a great GTA game. The story and the overall direction of the game feel weird and don't fit into the series and this is a big Problem. It just doesn't feel like the GTA I grew up loving. GTA IV had Niko Bellic, a character with an actual past, personal struggles and a story that made you think. It was a unforgettable Story and full of immersion. GTA V had three completely different protagonists with their own personalities, problems and motivations. Both games had memorable characters, dark humor and that typical Rockstar atmosphere. With GTA 6 I don't get that same feeling, not even nearly. The whole Jason and Lucia relationship doesn't really interest me that much it feels completly wrong in the GTA series. It feels like Jason is a completly simp an you can feel that again and again moving on in the Story.  I understand what Rockstar is trying to do with the Bonnie and Clyde concept, but I personally expected something darker, more unpredictable and more focused on crime, betrayal and memorable characters. Instead, the direction feels way too focused on the relationship itself, and I don't get why they would do that. For me its fully predictable and boring. There are so many possible stories which are far more interesting. And also the restrictions in the Game are just ridiculous. My biggest problem is that Rockstar seems to be moving away from the offensive and politically incorrect humor that made GTA special. GTA used to make fun of absolutely everyone. Nobody was safe from its jokes, and that's exactly what I loved about it. I don't want GTA to feel like it has to be careful about offending people. I want morally questionable characters like Trevor, uncomfortable situations like with Niko, dark humor and a story that isn't afraid to go too far. That's what made the older games stand out. Honestly, one of the few things that genuinely got me excited again was seeing Niko Bellic return. To this day, he's one of the best characters Rockstar has ever written. His Story was one of the most outstanding and memorable in the whole GTA series. Maybe I'm just expecting too much because of how much the older Games meant to me. But after such a long wait, I wanted more than an incredibly realistic open world. I wanted a story and characters that could stand alongside GTA IV, GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2. The technical Achievement alone is without question outstanding, and probably no other game could reach this level. But as someone who cares more about storytelling, atmosphere and memorable characters than graphics, I think the direction Rockstar is going in is very bad and could destroy the series. For me, GTA 6 is the best GTA ever made if you just look at graphics and technical achievements, but it doesn't really feel like the GTA I know. And that's the most disappointing part.
